jobs.title: Graduate Town Planner - Birmingham or Nottingham
jobs.description:
Town Planning

UKIMEA Region



BIR0000SX Requisition #

Graduate Town Planner - Birmingham or Nottingham

See it differently - Early Careers at Arup

See it differently

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.

The Opportunity

With 150 town planners across 17 UK offices, Arup's Town Planning team works on some of the UK's most high-profile and complex projects, providing end-to-end planning and policy advice to public authorities, infrastructure providers, developers, property companies and landowners. Our work spans planning policy, spatial strategy, regeneration, major infrastructure planning, development management and research, helping to deliver more sustainable, resilient and inclusive places. As part of a multidisciplinary firm, we work closely with engineers, environmental specialists, urban designers and economists to tackle challenges such as housing delivery, climate change and infrastructure provision.

The role would be based within either our Birmingham or Nottingham offices, working as part of a wider national network of town planners. We are working on projects of national significance that will shape the future of the region. Our infrastructure work includes planning for the sustainable growth of Birmingham Airport, ensuring that the region has the energy it needs by planning for major new grid connections as well as working on new nationally important reservoirs. Our policy work includes working with both the East Midlands and West Midlands Combined Authorities to support the preparation of Spatial Development Strategies and establishing an exciting new vision for Nottingham’s future regeneration.

In this role you will:

Support the preparation of planning applications, planning policy documents, spatial strategies and evidence-based studies for public and private sector clients.

Undertake research, data analysis and report writing to inform planning, development, regeneration and major infrastructure projects, applying digital tools, GIS and AI-assisted techniques to interrogate evidence and communicate findings clearly.

Contribute to environmental, socio-economic and other impact assessments that support planning and consent processes.

Assist with stakeholder and community engagement activities, including workshops, consultations and meetings.

Work collaboratively as part of multi-disciplinary teams with planners, engineers, urban designers, environmental specialists, economists and other experts to deliver sustainable and inclusive places.

Help us use digital and AI tools well – from spatial data, dashboards and visualisation to automating routine policy and site analysis – so that our advice is quicker to produce, easier to understand and better evidenced.

https://www.arup.com/projects/ratcliffe-on-soar-power-station-site/

Is this role right for you?

For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:

An undergraduate or bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, such as Urban Planning, Architecture, Geography & Geospatial Science or Urban Design. RTPI-accredited degrees are preferred, and we will support you through your RTPI Assessment of Professional Competence.

Desirable technical skills include experience using GIS, mapping or spatial analysis software (e.g. ArcGIS or QGIS); comfort with data handling and visualisation tools (e.g. Excel, Power BI); and a practical, critical interest in how AI and automation can be applied responsibly to planning tasks such as evidence review, consultation analysis, site appraisal and reporting.

To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:

Full working rights in the country of application

No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role

Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes;

* Changemakers: You care about sustainable development and want to see your work make a genuine difference.

* Innovative minds: You think critically, ask hard questions, and are genuinely open to new approaches.

* Growth seekers: You are curious, actively seek feedback, and look for ways to keep developing.

* Adaptable adventurers: You are comfortable with uncertainty and adapt readily as projects and priorities evolve.

You should be able to start this opportunity on **1 September 2027.**

**Advert Closing Date:** **16 October 2026**

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.

**Eligibility:**

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.

What we offer you

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

jobs.title: GIS Analyst-Research
jobs.description:
TSCG, a privately held, commercial real estate company, is hiring a Location Data Analyst in our Atlanta, Georgia office. **This position is an in-office position with the ability to have 1 day remote after initial training period.**

**Reports To:** Director of GIS

Since 1984, our retail real estate platform has provided a full assortment of advisory services to tenants, landlords, developers, investors, and financial institutions throughout our territory. Our work on their behalf is dedicated to the validation of those descriptions. With 21 offices throughout the eastern U.S., we are the largest firm in our field in the United States.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

TSCG fosters a learning and open-door environment where the sky is the limit for what you can learn and how you can contribute to the team. We have a competitive benefits package with generous PTO, and you’ll always hear our Executives say, “Don’t miss your daughter’s game or that birthday dinner for your mom tonight!” We support each other and have a commitment to being the best that we can be and exceeding expectations.

TSCG celebrates our diversity and individual distinctiveness. We commit to working together in harmony to support our families and our communities, driving innovation in a highly competitive environment.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree required in GIS, Geography, Geoinformatics, or a related discipline (an Economics or Urban Planning degree with ArcGIS Pro experience is acceptable)
* Beginner-level knowledge of ArcGIS Pro. TSCG is an all-Esri shop (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Business Analyst)
* Commercial real estate GIS experience **a plus**
* Experience with AI tools such as Anthropic’s Claude **a plus**

**Attributes:**

* Highly organized with the ability to multi-task, prioritize and meet deadlines
* Self-starter who finds ways to exceed expectations
* Find new ways to be effective and efficient
* Ability to work with limited supervision
* Confident presenting findings and recommendations to coworkers, brokers, and clients, both technical and non-technical
* Accepting of new technologies with desire to adopt newest processes and workflows
* Ability to collaborate, teach and continually learn
* Passion for visual storytelling using a variety of tools

**Essential Functions:**

* Manage GIS requests for the Atlanta office in partnership with the other Atlanta-based GIS team member, from intake through final delivery, with full ownership of workload, priorities, and deadlines
* Consult with brokers to understand each transaction and recommend the appropriate mapping or analysis, then produce the required materials (i.e. maps, demographic reports or analysis, web-based applications, etc.)
* Stay current on Georgia retail trends, including retail openings and closures, new-to-market concepts, traffic counts, and future developments

**Technical Skills:**

* Build clean, well-designed maps in ArcGIS Pro using company layout templates, symbology standards, and cartographic best practices
* Work with spatial data in file and enterprise geodatabases and common formats, and run standard geoprocessing and analysis workflows (Network Analyst and Spatial Analyst experience **a plus)**
* Create and share web maps, Experiences, dashboards, and StoryMaps in ArcGIS Online
* Build trade areas, drive times, and demographic reports and infographics in ArcGIS Business Analyst
* Understand what demographic and market data measures and how to present it to a non-technical audience
* Clean and prepare tabular data in Excel for mapping and analysis
* Use AI tools such as Claude in daily work
* Comfortable in Microsoft 365

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Paid time off (including 11 paid holidays)
* Discretionary performance bonus

**Leading With Purpose**

Our goal is to sustain and grow a real estate services firm with a focus on long-term sustainability for our stakeholders, clients, properties, and operations. Achieving this vision requires every owner, manager, and employee to champion and uphold our Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles. These principles are integrated into all aspects of our business, from evaluating opportunities and investments to collaborating with landlords, investors, and occupier clients. By embedding ESG into our processes, we are committed to creating value, reducing risk, and enhancing client returns, while fostering a positive and supportive workplace for our team.

**United by Purpose**

TSCG is committed to creating an environment where all talents, perspectives, and experiences are valued. We believe that embracing our differences makes us stronger and drives our success. Together, we support our families, communities, and each other, fostering innovation in a competitive landscape.

*TSCG is an affirmative action, equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, disability, citizenship status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Staff Geospatial Analyst
jobs.description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.

*Export Control/ITAR:* Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**Please review the job details below.**

**Senior GIS Analyst – Synthetic Environments**

We are seeking an experienced Senior GIS Analyst to support the development of high-fidelity synthetic environments for defense training, mission rehearsal, and operational analysis systems.

This role will focus on the acquisition, extraction, attribution, editing, transformation, quality control, and maintenance of curated geospatial vector data used in terrain generation and modeling, simulation, and training environments. The Senior GIS Analyst will work closely with product owners, software engineers, data specialists, and subject-matter experts to deliver accurate, interoperable, and production-ready geospatial content.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in GIS data processing, terrain database generation, geospatial automation, and 3D simulation content development. This position also requires the ability to lead technical efforts, establish repeatable workflows, mentor less-experienced analysts, and support delivery within an Agile development environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the preparation and processing of geospatial datasets for synthetic-environment and simulation applications.
* Acquire and compile geospatial data from diverse sources, including satellite imagery, orthorectified and georeferenced imagery, hardcopy charts, field observations, existing maps, OpenStreetMap, and local government sources.
* Extract, digitize, clean, attribute, edit, generalize, validate, and maintain curated vector features, including transportation, hydrography, structures, vegetation, terrain, and other terrain-related content.
* Review and refine AI-extracted features and other machine-assisted source data for geometry, attribution, completeness, usability, and production readiness.
* Perform spatial analysis, coordinate-system transformations, conflation, generalization, and data conversion.

* Process imagery, vector features, hydrography, transportation networks, structures, vegetation, and other terrain-related data.
* Develop and enforce GIS data standards, schemas, metadata requirements, and quality-control procedures.
* Conduct detailed geospatial quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), including topology validation, geometry checks, attribution reviews, completeness assessments, and positional accuracy evaluations.
* Develop repeatable workflows and automation scripts to improve data-processing efficiency and consistency.
* Produce technical documentation, processing guides, data dictionaries, test procedures, and project reports.
* Support software testing, component testing, technical demonstrations, user evaluations, source incorporation, and stakeholder engagements.

* Participate in Agile planning, sprint reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
* Collaborate with product owners, engineers, developers, testers, and other GIS professionals.
* Provide mentorship to junior and mid-level analysts.
* Work effectively in security-conscious development environments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Cartography, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* At least 7 years of professional experience in GIS, geospatial data processing, terrain-data production, or a related field.
* Advanced working knowledge of Esri ArcGIS, including ArcGIS Pro and/or ArcMap.
* Professional experience with Safe Software FME for data transformation, translation, validation, and workflow automation.
* Working knowledge of QGIS and open-source geospatial tools.
* Strong understanding of coordinate reference systems, projections, datums, georeferencing, geospatial data models, and metadata.
* Experience processing common GIS formats, including shapefiles, file geodatabases, GeoPackages, GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, imagery, raster elevation data, and point clouds.
* Experience with geospatial data quality assurance and quality control.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Ability to obtain and maintain any required security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with terrain database generation or geospatial content development for modeling, simulation, and training systems.
* Experience with 3D GIS, multipatch data, 3D mesh, LiDAR, point clouds, photogrammetry, or digital elevation models.
* Experience using GeoMedia, Global Mapper, OSGViewer, Creator, GIMP, or comparable geospatial visualization tools.

* Familiarity with spatial databases and enterprise GIS, including PostgreSQL/PostGIS and ArcGIS Enterprise.
* Familiarity with Agile software development and issue-tracking with Jira.
* Familiarity with testing, configuration management, version control, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience working with 3D Tiles.
* Familiarity with web GIS, OGC services, and geospatial APIs, including WMS, WMTS, WFS, REST, and GeoPackage.

**Competencies**

Data stewardship • Geospatial analysis • Imagery interpretation • Vector editing and attribution • QA/QC • Production workflow design

jobs.company: The City of Crown Point, IN
jobs.title: Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
As the Assistant Planner, you are responsible for the case management of major land development applications, under the supervision of the Planning Administrator.

The Assistant Planner is also responsible for the review and analysis of subdivision plats, zoning changes, and text amendments. This includes reviewing commercial and residential permits along with being able to read and review construction and engineering plans.

The additional responsibilities of this position consist of working on comprehensive planning projects independently or in support of the ongoing long-range and special projects relating to annexation, code amendments, land use plans, and economic development programs.

* Reviews development proposals for compliance with the Comprehensive Plan and development regulations pertaining to zoning, subdivision, parking and landscaping. Acts as case manager on new commercial project applications.
* Reviews building permit applications and engineering civil plans for zoning compliance. Investigates zoning complaints and is a witness on zoning violations. Reviews variance and special exception permit applications. May assist in annexation work. Prepares and posts notice of public hearings.
* Conducts extensive research in specific or general project areas. Writes, or assist in writing, regulations relating to land development and updates guiding documents, i.e. the Comprehensive Plan.
* Assumes project management and design role for major planning initiatives and special projects to implement the city goals, including overseeing work of consultants, conferring with other departments, citizens, civic leaders, neighborhood groups, developers, real estate agencies and engineers.
* Uses permit tracking software to track land development cases and to prepare reports.
* Managing the computer for Zoom meetings along with creating minutes for all Plan Commission, BZA and HPRES meetings.
* Performing all other related duties as assigned.

**Desired minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred in planning, landscape architecture, architecture, engineering, geography or closely related field from an accredited college or university.
* One to three years related experience in urban design and/or urban planning or closely related field.
* Familiar with permit tracking software, Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe products.
* Strong customer service skills, ability to work effectively with a wide variety of people and situations.
* Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.

**Work environment/schedule:**

In this position, it is paramount to excel in written and oral communication; public speaking and presentation; and critical thinking and problem solving. It is also important to be able to create, read and interpret maps, read and review building plans (residential and commercial), engineering reports and prepares statistical analyses using Geographic Information System (GIS). Experience and knowledge of development review, planning practices and principles is required. Ability to manipulate within ARC/GIS when needed and be able to operate City permit tracking software.

Attendance is an essential function of this position and in the event of an emergency this position may be required to work in order to perform essential services needed to sustain City operations. The typical schedule is Monday – Friday from 7am to 3pm as well as regularly scheduled evening meetings of the Plan Commission, Board of Zoning Appeals and Historic Preservation Commission.

The City of Crown Point is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer of qualified individuals.

*Please note: The duties listed above are intended as general descriptions of the work performed by persons assigned to this position, not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. This position description does not constitute an employment contract and is subject to change as required.*

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $39,998.40 - $75,168.34 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

License/Certification:

* Driver's License (Required)

Work Location: In person

Since 1984, our retail real estate platform has provided a full assortment of advisory services to tenants, landlords, developers, investors, and financial institutions throughout our territory. Our work on their behalf is dedicated to the validation of those descriptions. With 21 offices throughout the eastern U.S., we are the largest firm in our field in the United States.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

TSCG fosters a learning and open-door environment where the sky is the limit for what you can learn and how you can contribute to the team. We have a competitive benefits package with generous PTO, and you’ll always hear our Executives say, “Don’t miss your daughter’s game or that birthday dinner for your mom tonight!” We support each other and have a commitment to being the best that we can be and exceeding expectations.

* Beginner-level knowledge of ArcGIS Pro. TSCG is an all-Esri shop (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Business Analyst)
* Commercial real estate GIS experience **a plus**

new_jobs.title: Staff Geospatial Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.

*Export Control/ITAR:* Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**Please review the job details below.**

**Senior GIS Analyst – Synthetic Environments**

We are seeking an experienced Senior GIS Analyst to support the development of high-fidelity synthetic environments for defense training, mission rehearsal, and operational analysis systems.

This role will focus on the acquisition, extraction, attribution, editing, transformation, quality control, and maintenance of curated geospatial vector data used in terrain generation and modeling, simulation, and training environments. The Senior GIS Analyst will work closely with product owners, software engineers, data specialists, and subject-matter experts to deliver accurate, interoperable, and production-ready geospatial content.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in GIS data processing, terrain database generation, geospatial automation, and 3D simulation content development. This position also requires the ability to lead technical efforts, establish repeatable workflows, mentor less-experienced analysts, and support delivery within an Agile development environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the preparation and processing of geospatial datasets for synthetic-environment and simulation applications.
* Acquire and compile geospatial data from diverse sources, including satellite imagery, orthorectified and georeferenced imagery, hardcopy charts, field observations, existing maps, OpenStreetMap, and local government sources.
* Extract, digitize, clean, attribute, edit, generalize, validate, and maintain curated vector features, including transportation, hydrography, structures, vegetation, terrain, and other terrain-related content.
* Review and refine AI-extracted features and other machine-assisted source data for geometry, attribution, completeness, usability, and production readiness.
* Perform spatial analysis, coordinate-system transformations, conflation, generalization, and data conversion.

* Process imagery, vector features, hydrography, transportation networks, structures, vegetation, and other terrain-related data.
* Develop and enforce GIS data standards, schemas, metadata requirements, and quality-control procedures.
* Conduct detailed geospatial quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), including topology validation, geometry checks, attribution reviews, completeness assessments, and positional accuracy evaluations.
* Develop repeatable workflows and automation scripts to improve data-processing efficiency and consistency.
* Produce technical documentation, processing guides, data dictionaries, test procedures, and project reports.
* Support software testing, component testing, technical demonstrations, user evaluations, source incorporation, and stakeholder engagements.

* Participate in Agile planning, sprint reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
* Collaborate with product owners, engineers, developers, testers, and other GIS professionals.
* Provide mentorship to junior and mid-level analysts.
* Work effectively in security-conscious development environments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Cartography, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* At least 7 years of professional experience in GIS, geospatial data processing, terrain-data production, or a related field.
* Advanced working knowledge of Esri ArcGIS, including ArcGIS Pro and/or ArcMap.
* Professional experience with Safe Software FME for data transformation, translation, validation, and workflow automation.
* Working knowledge of QGIS and open-source geospatial tools.
* Strong understanding of coordinate reference systems, projections, datums, georeferencing, geospatial data models, and metadata.
* Experience processing common GIS formats, including shapefiles, file geodatabases, GeoPackages, GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, imagery, raster elevation data, and point clouds.
* Experience with geospatial data quality assurance and quality control.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Ability to obtain and maintain any required security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with terrain database generation or geospatial content development for modeling, simulation, and training systems.
* Experience with 3D GIS, multipatch data, 3D mesh, LiDAR, point clouds, photogrammetry, or digital elevation models.
* Experience using GeoMedia, Global Mapper, OSGViewer, Creator, GIMP, or comparable geospatial visualization tools.

* Familiarity with spatial databases and enterprise GIS, including PostgreSQL/PostGIS and ArcGIS Enterprise.
* Familiarity with Agile software development and issue-tracking with Jira.
* Familiarity with testing, configuration management, version control, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience working with 3D Tiles.
* Familiarity with web GIS, OGC services, and geospatial APIs, including WMS, WMTS, WFS, REST, and GeoPackage.

**Competencies**

Data stewardship • Geospatial analysis • Imagery interpretation • Vector editing and attribution • QA/QC • Production workflow design

new_jobs.company: The City of Crown Point, IN
new_jobs.title: Assistant Planner
new_jobs.description:
As the Assistant Planner, you are responsible for the case management of major land development applications, under the supervision of the Planning Administrator.

The Assistant Planner is also responsible for the review and analysis of subdivision plats, zoning changes, and text amendments. This includes reviewing commercial and residential permits along with being able to read and review construction and engineering plans.

The additional responsibilities of this position consist of working on comprehensive planning projects independently or in support of the ongoing long-range and special projects relating to annexation, code amendments, land use plans, and economic development programs.

* Reviews development proposals for compliance with the Comprehensive Plan and development regulations pertaining to zoning, subdivision, parking and landscaping. Acts as case manager on new commercial project applications.
* Reviews building permit applications and engineering civil plans for zoning compliance. Investigates zoning complaints and is a witness on zoning violations. Reviews variance and special exception permit applications. May assist in annexation work. Prepares and posts notice of public hearings.
* Conducts extensive research in specific or general project areas. Writes, or assist in writing, regulations relating to land development and updates guiding documents, i.e. the Comprehensive Plan.
* Assumes project management and design role for major planning initiatives and special projects to implement the city goals, including overseeing work of consultants, conferring with other departments, citizens, civic leaders, neighborhood groups, developers, real estate agencies and engineers.
* Uses permit tracking software to track land development cases and to prepare reports.
* Managing the computer for Zoom meetings along with creating minutes for all Plan Commission, BZA and HPRES meetings.
* Performing all other related duties as assigned.

**Desired minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred in planning, landscape architecture, architecture, engineering, geography or closely related field from an accredited college or university.
* One to three years related experience in urban design and/or urban planning or closely related field.
* Familiar with permit tracking software, Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe products.
* Strong customer service skills, ability to work effectively with a wide variety of people and situations.
* Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.

**Work environment/schedule:**

In this position, it is paramount to excel in written and oral communication; public speaking and presentation; and critical thinking and problem solving. It is also important to be able to create, read and interpret maps, read and review building plans (residential and commercial), engineering reports and prepares statistical analyses using Geographic Information System (GIS). Experience and knowledge of development review, planning practices and principles is required. Ability to manipulate within ARC/GIS when needed and be able to operate City permit tracking software.

Attendance is an essential function of this position and in the event of an emergency this position may be required to work in order to perform essential services needed to sustain City operations. The typical schedule is Monday – Friday from 7am to 3pm as well as regularly scheduled evening meetings of the Plan Commission, Board of Zoning Appeals and Historic Preservation Commission.

The City of Crown Point is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer of qualified individuals.

This position description does not constitute an employment contract and is subject to change as required.*
